question: What is one of the best ways to keep our bodies fit and strong? 🏃
explanation: Awesome! Playing sports and doing exercise every day helps our bodies stay fit and our minds stay sharp! ⚽
hint: It involves running and moving around.

question: Which of these is the healthiest drink for our body? 💧
explanation: Super! Drinking plenty of clean water keeps our body fresh and energetic all day long! 💧
hint: It is clear and has no color.

question: What kind of food makes our muscles strong? 🍎
explanation: Great job! Eating fresh fruits and vegetables gives us strength and keeps us healthy! 🍎
hint: They grow on trees and plants.

question: How does daily exercise make us feel? 😊
